name: Camber Labs 2026 Game Storefront & Engine Royalty Dataset

storefronts.name: Steam (Valve)
storefronts.upfrontNote: $100 Steam Direct app fee (recoupable once gross sales pass $1,000)
storefronts.payoutSchedule: Monthly (~30 days after month-end; $100 min threshold)
storefronts.bestFor: Full commercial PC indie launches, wishlist funnels & Steam Next Fest discovery

storefronts.name: itch.io (Direct Stripe Mode)

tiers.label: Direct to You (0% Open Rev-Share + Stripe)

storefronts.upfrontNote: $0 upfront listing fee; creator chooses 0%–10%+ open revenue share with UK/US Stripe Direct payouts
storefronts.payoutSchedule: Direct to your Stripe/PayPal bank (~2–7 business days, £1+ settlement)
storefronts.bestFor: Game-dev tools, asset packs, prototypes, demos & paid HTML5/ZIP bundles with zero upfront fee

storefronts.name: Epic Games Store
storefronts.upfrontNote: $100 submission fee per product + 0% Unreal Engine royalty waiver on EGS sales
storefronts.payoutSchedule: Quarterly / monthly depending on settlement threshold ($100 min)
storefronts.bestFor: Unreal Engine titles avoiding the 5% UE royalty above $1M gross

storefronts.name: GOG.com
storefronts.upfrontNote: Curated DRM-free storefront ($0 listing fee; selective acceptance)
storefronts.bestFor: DRM-free RPGs, strategy sims & retro revivals as a secondary PC store after Steam

storefronts.name: Humble Store (Direct / Widget)
storefronts.upfrontNote: 75% developer share on Store (~15% Humble + 10% Charity); 95/5 on self-hosted Humble Widget minus card fees
storefronts.bestFor: Curated indie PC Steam-key promotions & website direct sales

storefronts.name: Apple App Store
storefronts.upfrontNote: $99/yr Apple Developer membership; 15% Small Business Program rate applies under $1M net/year
storefronts.bestFor: Premium iOS games & iPad ports under $1M annual net revenue

storefronts.name: Google Play Store
storefronts.upfrontNote: $25 one-time Play Console registration; 15% service fee on the first $1M/yr annual revenue
storefronts.bestFor: Android premium titles & mobile ports under $1M annual revenue

storefronts.name: Nintendo Switch eShop
storefronts.upfrontNote: Requires approved Switch publisher/developer devkit access (~$450 devkit hardware)
storefronts.bestFor: 2D metroidvanias, roguelikes, farming sims & cozy pixel indies

storefronts.name: PlayStation Store (PS4/PS5)
storefronts.upfrontNote: Requires SIE Partners registration & console certification/age ratings
storefronts.bestFor: Action RPGs, narrative indies & controller-first PC ports

storefronts.name: Microsoft Store / Xbox
storefronts.upfrontNote: 12% cut for PC games on Microsoft Store; 30% standard on Xbox Console hardware (~$19 partner individual fee)
storefronts.bestFor: Dual PC/Console MS Store releases & ID@Xbox Game Pass pipelines

engines.name: Godot 4
engines.note: MIT open-source — $0 seat fees & 0% gross revenue royalty forever.

engines.name: Unity (Personal / Pro)
engines.note: 0% runtime fee; Unity Pro (~$2,200/yr/seat) required above $200k trailing 12-mo revenue.

engines.name: Unreal Engine 5
engines.note: 5% gross royalty on gross revenue exceeding $1M lifetime (0% waived on Epic Games Store).

engines.name: GameMaker
engines.note: Free non-commercial / $99.99 one-time Commercial license — 0% revenue royalty.
